description: Flat metadata schema for individual records of bioactive compounds isolated from traditional medicinal plants, characterized by chromatography and spectroscopy, and evaluated for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory bioactivity to support nutraceutical standardization and health-claim evidence.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual dataset record.

record_date.descr: Date the record was created or finalized (YYYY-MM-DD).

plant_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the source medicinal plant.

plant_family.descr: Botanical family of the source plant.

plant_part_used.descr: Plant material analyzed, e.g., leaf, root, bark, seed, flower.

traditional_use.descr: Traditional medicinal use context or indication associated with the plant.

geographic_origin.descr: Geographic source of the plant material, e.g., country, region, or locality.

voucher_specimen_id.descr: Herbarium or voucher specimen identifier, if available.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date the plant sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_preparation_method.descr: How the plant material was prepared before extraction, e.g., dried, powdered, lyophilized.

extraction_solvent.descr: Primary solvent or solvent system used for extraction, e.g., methanol, ethanol-water 70:30.

extraction_method.descr: Extraction technique used, e.g., maceration, Soxhlet, ultrasound-assisted extraction.

extract_yield_percent.descr: Mass yield of crude extract as percentage of starting dry material (% w/w).

fractionation_method.descr: Method used to fractionate or enrich the extract, if applicable.

isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the compound, e.g., preparative HPLC, flash chromatography, TLC-guided isolation.

compound_name.descr: Common or trivial name of the isolated compound.

compound_class.descr: Chemical class of the compound, e.g., flavonoid, alkaloid, terpenoid, phenolic acid.

compound_identifier.descr: Database or internal identifier for the compound, such as InChIKey, PubChem CID, or internal code.

molecular_formula.descr: Empirical molecular formula of the compound.

purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound in percent.

chromatography_technique.descr: Chromatographic technique used for separation/analysis, e.g., HPLC, UHPLC, GC-MS, LC-MS.

chromatography_column.descr: Column type or stationary phase used in chromatography.

chromatography_mobile_phase.descr: Mobile phase composition or gradient description used in chromatography.

retention_factor_k.descr: Retention factor or related chromatographic parameter, if reported.

detector_type.descr: Detector used in chromatography, e.g., UV, PDA, MS, ELSD.

chromatography_wavelength_nm.descr: Detection wavelength in nanometers, if applicable.

chromatography_ms_mode.descr: Mass spectrometry ionization or acquisition mode, if applicable, e.g., ESI+, ESI-, MRM.

chromatography_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the compound, if applicable.

spectroscopy_method.descr: Spectroscopic method used for structural elucidation, e.g., NMR, IR, MS, UV-Vis, CD.

nmr_type.descr: Type of NMR experiment, e.g., 1H NMR, 13C NMR, HSQC, HMBC.

nmr_solvent.descr: Solvent used for NMR analysis, e.g., CDCl3, DMSO-d6.

ir_peak_cm1.descr: Key infrared absorption peak position in wavenumbers (cm^-1), if reported.

uv_max_nm.descr: UV-Vis absorption maximum in nanometers, if reported.

structural_assignment_confidence.descr: Confidence level for compound structural identification, e.g., confirmed, probable, tentative.

reference_standard_used.descr: Indicates whether an authenticated reference standard was used for confirmation (yes/no).

bioassay_type.descr: Primary biological assay used to evaluate activity, e.g., DPPH, ABTS, FRAP, cell-based cytokine assay.

bioactivity_category.descr: Bioactivity class assessed, e.g., antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, or both.

cell_line_used.descr: Cell line or primary cell type used in the assay, if applicable.

assay_target.descr: Measured biological target or endpoint, e.g., ROS scavenging, NO inhibition, TNF-alpha, IL-6.

assay_concentration.descr: Test concentration of the compound in the assay, with units typically µM or µg/mL as recorded.

assay_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for assay concentration, e.g., µM, µg/mL, mg/mL.

ic50.descr: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration, reported in the assay's concentration unit.

ec50.descr: Half-maximal effective concentration, reported in the assay's concentration unit.

percent_inhibition.descr: Observed percent inhibition or scavenging at the specified test concentration (%).

control_type.descr: Control used in the assay, e.g., vehicle, positive control compound, untreated cells.

positive_control_name.descr: Name of the positive control compound or reference standard used, if any.

replicate_number.descr: Number of experimental replicates used for the reported measurement.

statistical_significance_p.descr: P-value associated with the reported bioactivity result, if available.

toxicity_observed.descr: Indicates whether toxicity or cytotoxicity was observed at tested concentrations (yes/no).

standardization_marker.descr: Marker compound proposed for standardization of the nutraceutical product.

marker_threshold_value.descr: Recommended threshold or acceptance value for the marker compound in product standardization.

marker_threshold_unit.descr: Unit for the standardization threshold, e.g., mg/g, % w/w, µg/mL.

health_claim_support_level.descr: Extent to which the record supports a health-related claim, e.g., strong, moderate, preliminary.

nutraceutical_relevance.descr: Brief note on relevance to nutraceutical formulation, standardization, or product development.

data_source_reference.descr: Citation, DOI, report ID, or source document supporting the record.

analyst_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person or team generating the record, if needed.
